name: ClickSyncr for Brevo – Contact Form 7 Integration
author: ClickSyncr

sections.description:
ClickSyncr is a Brevo integration for Contact Form 7. It connects your forms to Brevo (formerly Sendinblue), sending each configured submission to the Brevo list you choose and mapping Contact Form 7 fields to Brevo contact attributes. Learn more about the Contact Form 7 to Brevo integration.

Connect with a Brevo v3 API key, choose a list, and map the required email field plus the standard or custom Brevo attributes you want to sync. Because Brevo identifies contacts by email address, submitting the same email again updates the existing contact instead of creating a duplicate.

“Brevo” and “Sendinblue” are trademarks of Sendinblue SAS. This plugin is an independent integration and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Sendinblue SAS or Brevo.

Brevo Integration for Contact Form 7

  • Connect inside Contact Form 7 — enter a Brevo v3 API key in the ClickSyncr Brevo tab. No developers, no code.
  • Choose a Brevo list — select the destination independently for each Contact Form 7 form.
  • Map contact attributes — map the email field and the standard or custom attributes from your Brevo account.
  • Configure forms independently — use different Brevo lists and field mappings for different forms.
  • Keep your existing workflow — Contact Form 7 continues to handle the form and its normal email notification.
  • Stay in control of your data — only the email address and the fields you map are sent to Brevo when a configured form is submitted.

How it works

  1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Edit any Contact Form 7 form and open the ClickSyncr Brevo tab.
  3. Paste your Brevo v3 API key — your lists and contact attributes load in the editor.
  4. Choose a list and map your form fields to Brevo attributes (email is required).
  5. Save the form. Every submission is now synced to Brevo.

What you’ll need

  • WordPress 6.7 or higher
  • Contact Form 7 installed and activated
  • A Brevo account with a v3 API key

Getting your Brevo API key

  1. Log in to your Brevo account.
  2. Go to Settings > SMTP & API > API Keys.
  3. Generate a new v3 API key.
  4. Paste it into the ClickSyncr Brevo tab.

Support

Need a hand? Visit clicksyncr.com and we’ll be glad to help.

External service: Brevo

This plugin connects to Brevo, the email marketing service, to sync your Contact Form 7 submissions with your Brevo account.

When data is sent: when you connect your API key, when your lists and fields load in the form editor, and when a visitor submits a form you’ve configured with ClickSyncr — at which point their form data (email and any mapped fields) is sent to Brevo.

What is sent: your Brevo API key (to authenticate), the subscriber’s email address and any contact fields you choose to map, and the list you select.

By using this plugin you agree to Brevo’s Privacy Policy. You are responsible for complying with applicable data-protection laws (such as GDPR) and for obtaining consent from your visitors before their data is collected and sent to Brevo.
sections.installation:
Automatic installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New.
  3. Search for “ClickSyncr for Brevo”.
  4. Click Install Now, then Activate.

Manual installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file.
  2. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  3. Choose the ZIP file and click Install Now.
  4. Activate the plugin.

After installation

  1. Make sure Contact Form 7 is installed and activated.
  2. Edit any Contact Form 7 form and open the ClickSyncr Brevo tab.
  3. Follow the on-screen setup. Full guidance is on the ClickSyncr for Brevo page.
sections.faq:
How do I connect Contact Form 7 to Brevo?

Edit a Contact Form 7 form, open the ClickSyncr Brevo tab, enter a Brevo v3 API key, choose a list, and map the form’s email field to Brevo. Save the form and submit a test entry to confirm the contact is created or updated.

Can Contact Form 7 add contacts to a Brevo list?

Yes. ClickSyncr sends submissions from each configured Contact Form 7 form to the Brevo list selected in that form’s settings.

Does this Contact Form 7 integration work with Sendinblue?

Yes. Sendinblue is now named Brevo. ClickSyncr connects to the current Brevo v3 API and works with your Brevo account.

Can I map custom Brevo attributes?

Yes. ClickSyncr loads the available contact attributes from the connected Brevo account, so Contact Form 7 fields can be mapped to standard or custom attributes.

Do I need a Brevo account?

Yes. You’ll need an active Brevo account and a v3 API key to sync your contacts.

Where do I find my Brevo API key?

Log in to Brevo, go to Settings > SMTP & API > API Keys, and generate a new v3 API key.

Can I use different settings for different forms?

Yes. Every Contact Form 7 form has its own ClickSyncr Brevo setup, so each can sync to a different list with its own field mapping.
